wiki.title: Mia Costello
wiki.extract: Mia C. Costello (born January 11, 1968) is a Republican politician from Alaska. She is a member of the Alaska House of Representatives from the 15th district. She previously represented the 20th district from 2011 to 2015 and served as a member of the Alaska Senate, representing District K from 2015 to 2023.
